flags.why: Standalone ghẹo meaning ‘to tease’ is mainly Southern usage, which needs a regional label ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gh%E1%BA%B9o)).
Cho hay meaning ‘let someone know’ is also natural in casual conversation, including the supplied example.

This literary expression introduces an inference or conclusion, whereas ‘as a result’ incorrectly expresses a consequence ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-cho%20hay)).
flags.fix: it goes to show that; as one can infer
